description: Spoken writing directions versus recipient content. Expected drafts are examples, not exact-match semantic scores.

cases.spoken: Tell Alex I will be ten minutes late. Keep it casual.
cases.exampleDraft: Hey Alex, I'll be ten minutes late.

cases.spoken: We shipped the update. Make that more formal.
cases.exampleDraft: We have released the update.

cases.spoken: Keep this warm and short. Tell Maya the preview is ready for review.
cases.exampleDraft: Maya, the preview is ready for your review.

cases.spoken: Put this in two bullets: the build is ready and testing starts Tuesday.
cases.exampleDraft:
- The build is ready.
- Testing starts Tuesday.

cases.spoken: The review is on Tuesday and I might join late.
cases.exampleDraft: The review is on Tuesday, and I might join late.

cases.spoken: Can you send me the report by Friday?
cases.exampleDraft: Can you send me the report by Friday?

cases.spoken: Tell Alex to keep the announcement casual.
cases.exampleDraft: Alex, please keep the announcement casual.

cases.spoken: Include the exact sentence "Keep it casual" in the note.
cases.exampleDraft: Keep it casual

cases.spoken: Ask Codex to investigate the crash without changing code. Keep the prompt short.
cases.exampleDraft: Investigate the crash without changing code.

cases.spoken: Ask the coding agent why the login fails. Do not make any changes.
cases.exampleDraft: Explain why login fails. Do not make any changes.

cases.spoken: Ask the coding agent to inspect src/Auth.swift with --verbose. Do not edit files. Make this a concise prompt.
cases.exampleDraft: Inspect src/Auth.swift with --verbose. Do not edit files.

cases.spoken: Ask the coding agent to find the string "make it shorter" in src/Copy.swift without editing files.
cases.exampleDraft: Find the string "make it shorter" in src/Copy.swift without editing files.

cases.spoken: Tell Sam the meeting is Tuesday, sorry, Thursday. Keep it short.
cases.exampleDraft: Sam, the meeting is Thursday.

cases.spoken: Tell Jo I cannot attend. Keep it polite and do not give a reason.
cases.exampleDraft: Jo, I'm sorry, but I can't attend.

cases.spoken: Make this shorter.
cases.exampleDraft: Make this shorter.

cases.spoken: Write a short note asking Lee to delete the draft after review.
cases.exampleDraft: Lee, please delete the draft after review.

cases.spoken: Hey, how's it going? Write this formally.
cases.exampleDraft: Hello, how are you?

cases.spoken: Okay, can you help me with this? Hey, how's it going? Write this formally.
cases.exampleDraft: Hello, how are you?

cases.spoken: Include the exact sentence "Write this formally" in the note.
cases.exampleDraft: Write this formally

cases.spoken: Tell Alex to write this formally.
cases.exampleDraft: Alex, please write this formally.

cases.spoken: Okay, can you help with this? Hey, how's it going? Write this formally.
cases.exampleDraft: Hello, how are you?

cases.spoken: I'm unsure, but I think it will work. Can you please write this as a response in Codex?
cases.exampleDraft: I'm unsure, but I think it will work.

cases.spoken: Investigate the crash. Do not edit files. Write this as a reply in Codex.
cases.exampleDraft: Investigate the crash. Do not edit files.

cases.spoken: Make this upbeat and brief. Tell Nora the rehearsal starts at nine.
cases.exampleDraft: Nora, the rehearsal starts at nine!
